paper.title_en: Carrier duality from the convergence of Dirac fermions and high-order van Hove singularities
paper.abstract_en: The convergence of highly mobile Dirac fermions and flat-band heavy electrons offers a paradigm for emergent quantum phenomena. However, experimental realization of such intriguing state remains elusive. In this study, we report a dual carrier regime in the kagome metal Co3In2S2, wherein the charge transport is governed by high-mobility electrons while the thermodynamic responses exhibit heavy-electron behavior. This exotic duality arises from the coexistence of topological Dirac fermions and flat-band high-order (4th-order) Van Hove singularities (HOVHSs) at the Fermi surface, as revealed by magnetic-torque quantum oscillation and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. The interaction between Dirac and HOVHS-derived carriers can be captured by a minimal two-pocket model, manifesting as sublinear resistivity above ~100 K and field-induced non-Fermi-liquid behavior at low temperatures. Our study establishes Co3In2S2 as a model platform for exploring many-body physics at the intersection of topology and correlation effects, and provides a foundational framework for designing quantum materials hosting diverse emergent states.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文报告了kagome金属Co3In2S2中由拓扑Dirac费米子与高阶范霍夫奇点共存导致的双载流子区域，并观测到非费米液体行为，与凝聚态全息/强关联电子主题相关，方法上结合磁转矩量子振荡与角分辨光电子能谱，具有中等理论深度与新颖性，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自Dirac费米子与高阶范霍夫奇点收敛的载流子对偶性
decision.abstract_zh: 高迁移率Dirac费米子与平带重电子的收敛为涌现量子现象提供了一种范式。然而，这种有趣状态的实验实现仍然难以捉摸。在本研究中，我们报道了kagome金属Co3In2S2中的双载流子区域，其中电荷输运由高迁移率电子主导，而热力学响应表现出重电子行为。这种奇异的对偶性源于费米面处拓扑Dirac费米子与平带高阶（四阶）范霍夫奇点（HOVHSs）的共存，这由磁转矩量子振荡和角分辨光电子能谱揭示。Dirac与HOVHS衍生载流子之间的相互作用可以用一个最小双口袋模型来捕获，表现为约100 K以上的亚线性电阻率以及低温下场诱导的非费米液体行为。我们的研究确立了Co3In2S2作为探索拓扑与关联效应交叉处多体物理的模型平台，并为设计承载多样涌现态的量子材料提供了一个基础框架。
